add_child.title: Add child device (1/2): choose a product template
add_child.description:
Pick a product template; the next page pre-fills the Huawei product parameters. Choose "Custom" when no template matches: you paste the device Profile JSON first and its parameters and services are detected automatically.

Huawei IoT catalog:
{catalog_links}

In the Profile: DeviceId → prod_id, deviceTypeId → device_type, deviceModel → model.

data_description.template: 9MU7 / 9MXO / 9MY5 are the product models Huawei provides for Home Assistant.

profile.title: Add child device (1/2): paste the device Profile

data_description.profile: The whole JSON block (from the opening to the closing brace); formatted or minified both work. Only single-product Profiles are supported, not the full mainHelp.json catalog.

add_product.title: Add child device (2/2): product identity and services

data_description.key: Leave empty to generate a key such as device_1. It is only used in the local YAML and storage and is never sent to Huawei; prefer ASCII, e.g. living_room_bulb.
data_description.prod_id: Huawei product ID, matching the Profile file name and DeviceId, e.g. 9MU7.
data_description.sub_prod_id: Sub-product ID, usually 00. When empty, "Report known fields only" must be enabled.
data_description.device_type: Huawei device type, matching the Profile deviceTypeId, e.g. 119.
data_description.model: Device model, matching the Profile deviceModel, e.g. haTest10.
data_description.friendly_name: Name shown in the Huawei Smart Life app.
data_description.room: Room name shown in the Huawei Smart Life app; optional.
data_description.protocol_type: Protocol type: 1 Wi-Fi, 3 Zigbee, 6 Bluetooth Mesh; see the README for the full table.
data_description.setup_type: Matches setupType in the Profile, usually 0.
data_description.known_fields_only: Report only the fields known to the Profile; required when sub_prod_id is empty.
data_description.services: Huawei services to project; the next step selects the HA entities per service. None can be selected: the device is then registered without projecting any service. Sids missing from this integration (e.g. warmSwitch, currentGasConsumption) cannot be projected; omit them.

edit_child.title: Edit child device
edit_child.description:
Select the child device to edit. Entries show "display name (key) · room"; without a display name only the key is shown.

To add a Chinese name, set the display name and save; it then appears in this list.

data_description.child: Outside the parentheses is the display name shown in the Huawei Smart Life app; inside is the key in mapping.yaml. Same names are told apart by room.

edit_product.title: Edit child device: {child}
edit_product.description: Only change what needs to change; keeping a selected service preserves its entity bindings and you can re-select the entities on the next step.

data_description.sub_prod_id: Sub-product ID, usually 00. When empty, "Report known fields only" must be enabled.
data_description.device_type: Huawei device type, matching the Profile deviceTypeId, e.g. 119.
data_description.model: Device model, matching the Profile deviceModel, e.g. haTest10.
data_description.friendly_name: Name shown in the Huawei Smart Life app; also shown in the edit/delete lists, so Chinese is recommended.
data_description.room: Room name shown in the Huawei Smart Life app; optional.
data_description.protocol_type: Protocol type: 1 Wi-Fi, 3 Zigbee, 6 Bluetooth Mesh; see the README for the full table.

data_description.known_fields_only: Report only the fields known to the Profile; required when sub_prod_id is empty.

service.title: Select entities ({index}/{total}): {label}
service.description:
Service {label} ({sid}). Select the HA entities it maps to; services without entities are ignored on save.

{hint}

data_description.st: Service type (st) normally stays unchanged; switch can be changed to binarySwitch as in the Profile. Adapters match sid exactly: st=switch with variant sids such as warmSwitch, heatSwitch or lightSwitch is not supported; omit those.
data_description.entities: Select the Home Assistant entities of this service; multiple allowed. Without entities the service is ignored on save.
data_description.contract: Optional. Match the Profile enum values, ranges or field names; when fields are used, the order must match the entity order above. Empty means adapter defaults; per the hint above some services reject or require a contract. YAML or JSON accepted.
data_description.back: On the first service this returns to the product form; on later services to the previous service. Re-submitting the product form keeps the entities and contracts already entered.

settings.title: Enable or disable the mapping
settings.description: Enable or disable the child-device mapping of this gateway. Disabling reloads immediately and removes the registered child devices from the Huawei cloud; enabling registers them again.

error.mac_not_found: Unable to read the MAC address of the selected network interface.
error.profile_invalid: The pasted Profile could not be parsed; make sure the whole single-product Profile JSON was copied.
error.invalid_key: Use 1-64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
error.sub_prod_id_requires_known_fields: "Report known fields only" must be enabled when sub_prod_id is empty.
error.invalid_contract: contract must be a YAML/JSON mapping.
error.contract_bool_key: YAML parsed on/off/yes/no inside contract as booleans; quote the key or value, e.g. 'on': 1 or 0: 'off'.
error.action_commands_required: action bound to non-cover/valve entities requires explicit commands, e.g. switches 0=off, 1=on; the vacuum 0=start, 1=pause, 2=cancel.
error.action_roles_invalid: contract.commands roles do not fit the selected entity domain; cover uses open/close/stop, switches use on/off, the vacuum uses start/pause/cancel.
error.electric_fields_required: electric requires fields in contract: use the characteristic names of the product Profile verbatim; their order and count must match the selected HA entities exactly.
error.electric_fields_entities_mismatch: electric fields must match the number of bound entities in the same order. To report only some fields, remove the extra fields and keep the remaining order.
error.status_cover_default: A cover state is open/closed, not on/off; adjust states per the Profile, e.g. closed=1, open=2.
error.status_mapping_required: status needs states or fallback; states may be an empty mapping plus a fallback, e.g. states: {} with fallback: 0.
error.status_states_invalid: status states must map HA states to integers, with quoted keys (e.g. 'on': 1) and integer values.
error.status_fallback_invalid: status fallback must be an integer.
error.yaml_invalid: The content is not a valid YAML mapping.
error.air_detector_entities_required: airDetector requires two different sensor entities (one temperature, one humidity).
error.gas_sensor_entities_required: gasSensor needs one current-concentration sensor and optionally one level sensor on a different entity.
error.placeholder_unfilled: The state/mode mapping still contains placeholders; replace the placeholder states with the values the device actually reports.

abort.invalid_gateway: The gateway serial number is invalid, so mapping.yaml cannot be accessed.
